text: INTERPRETER + AXON-OS: under a supervisor (AXON_OUTCOME_FD / AXON_OUTCOME_NONCE set), axon run writes one axon-outcome/1 record (kind, code, class, nonce) on a supervisor-only fd, removes both variables from its environment and marks the fd close-on-exec; other verbs refuse the variables (exit 2). axon-os capture and job classify decide a run from that record, never from stderr or the exit status; a missing, malformed, wrong-nonce or duplicate record is a sandbox refusal. Without the variables, axon run output and exit codes are byte-identical (714 tracked .ax files, check and run).
